summary: Core app scaffolding is present (routing, header with logo, Internet Identity hook/provider, product/order hooks, order status timeline). However, several explicit requirements are either incomplete or contradicted by the diff evidence (notably product catalog defaults and listing caller orders), and a few unrequested features were added (user profiles, social footer, admin token URL parameter initialization).

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend product catalog must have at least 8 sample products available by default after deployment, and expose query methods to list all products and fetch a product by id.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend code shown only adds 3 products, and they are only inserted via an admin-only initProducts() call (so they are not available by default after deployment unless an admin manually runs initialization). A get-by-id query method is not shown in the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend must expose a query method to list orders for the authenticated caller.
missing_requirements.reason: The frontend query hook for listing caller orders is stubbed to always return an empty array instead of calling the backend, indicating the required capability is not actually wired/implemented from the frontend side at minimum.

missing_requirements.requirement: Frontend shows a list of the user’s orders with current status and created date/time.
missing_requirements.reason: Because the caller-orders query hook always returns an empty list, the UI cannot display the user’s orders (status + createdAt) from real backend data.

hallucinated_features.description: User profile management and a mandatory profile setup modal (name capture) with backend userProfiles storage and related queries/mutations.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not ask for user profiles or a profile-creation flow; it only requires Internet Identity session and order association with principal.

hallucinated_features.description: Social media footer links/icons and “Built with caffeine.ai” footer content.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested in any requirement; BuildRequest focuses on storefront/cart/checkout/orders/tracking and cohesive theme.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin-token initialization via a secret URL parameter (caffeineAdminToken) and calling _initializeAccessControlWithSecret on the actor.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-8 requires admin-only status update restricted to configured principals in code; the diff introduces an additional secret-token mechanism not requested.
